about: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (official MXFP4/MXFP8 checkpoint) on 4x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, TP4, 512K, 16 sequences, as the owner serves it: kacper-daftcode/vLLM-Moet r21 (b0dc737: vLLM nightly df3bd094 + sm_120 steps 1-36: MXFP8 GEMV, FP4 KV record + MXFP4 indexer, b12x MoE with the fused decode kernel and the shared-expert add in its top-k sum, sparse-MLA gather loads, MXFP8 lm_heads, PCIe P2P all-reduce in NCCL's order, the drafter's input prep and the SWA decode/draft metadata builds in one launch each, DSA candidate blocks on the deterministic top-k), vLLM-Moet's Fraser-bench switch set, DSpark k=5, KV offload to 32 GiB host RAM + an in-container disk tier, and the engram_disk layer with its v3 library (Engram rows copied from a read-only mmap of the checkpoint on NVMe by a persistent worker pool, instead of ~330 GB of host shm). Lab-accepted 2026-11-12 on the reference host at 300 W per GPU: six gates, 407.7 tok/s on one stream, 13,533 tok/s prefill over a 351,853-token prompt; 8K cold prefill 15,280 tok/s, 480 tok/s total on four streams of long essays. Image: sybil-solutions/local-ai-images vllm-moet-dsv41 (r21-engram-v3).
setup: NEEDS: 4x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB (sm_120) in ONE machine with GPU peer-to-peer over PCIe (cudaDeviceCanAccessPeer true for every pair; the P2P all-reduce and NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS rely on it); host RAM: 66 GB free (a 63.3 GB MemAvailable drop was measured for this engine on the reference host; 32 GiB of it is the pinned KV offload region in the container's /dev/shm, hence --shm-size 48g); disk: 510.3 GB of weights on local NVMe (Engram rows are read from the checkpoint at every decode step) + the image (about 35 GB unpacked in Docker's store) + room for the KV disk tier, which writes into the container's own filesystem (/srv/kvcache, on Docker's disk) and goes away with it; needs.disk_gb counts the weights only. START: about 9 min on the reference host with nothing cached (FlashInfer autotune + DeepGEMM JIT + graph capture run in the container at every start, since nothing of it is kept outside). THIS IS the configuration served on the reference host (pop-os: Threadripper PRO 9965WX, 125 GiB RAM, PCIe 5.0, 300 W per GPU) since 2026-10-27: vLLM-Moet r21 with its Fraser-bench switch set, DSpark with 5 draft tokens (chosen over 7 there: more tokens per second at 2 and 4 streams), 16 sequences, and the engram_disk v3 library (rows copied from a read-only mmap of the checkpoint, a persistent worker pool). The numbers measured for this launch are in its proof and in data/sources/pop-os/2026-11-12-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-moet-r21. Lossy by design, as r13: the FP4 KV record, MXFP4 indexer keys, b12x 8-bit MoE activations and the MXFP8 target lm_head; every other switch is bit-identical to the path it replaces (VLLM_MOET_*=0 falls back to stock). Decode is power-bound: record the GPU power limit with any number.
